rule: Fail an explanation only when both verifiers fail it: v3 two-pass on claude-opus-5-5 (decideV3) AND v2 single-pass on Gemini 3.8 Flash (High) under the lenient rule (decideV2 'lenient'). Any missing or abstained verdict makes the result abstain.

how_it_was_chosen: Seven iterations on the dev set, logged in ITERATIONS.jsonl. Six decision rules were searched in it1 and two consensus combinations in it6. The dev numbers are optimistic by construction.
